matters.matter: Whether Nvidia closes its announced $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face
matters.why: A $12.9 billion cash deal that faces possible antitrust review and adds a large developer platform can change Nvidia's cash and competitive position, and a closing or abandonment announcement will settle it.

matters.matter: Combined new HBM production capacity SK Hynix, Micron and Samsung bring online in calendar 2027
matters.why: HBM supply limits how many GPUs Nvidia can ship and memory cost drives its gross margin, and the producers' 2027 reports and industry trackers will show how much capacity arrived.

matters.matter: Whether the HBM shortage and record prices ease in 2027 (new supply arriving before late 2027)
matters.why: This is the effect and timing of the same capacity additions, so an analyst would keep it on the same supply card rather than hold a separate bet.

matters.matter: Outstanding supply/purchase commitments in Nvidia's next annual report (FY ending January 2027)
matters.why: Commitments of about $119 billion lock in cash outlays and risk write-downs if AI demand slows, and the 10-K filed in early 2027 will disclose the amount on a known date.

matters.matter: Global semiconductor industry revenue in calendar 2026 (about $975 billion per Deloitte)
matters.why: An industry total that includes Nvidia's own sales reflects Nvidia's revenue rather than changing it, so it is background and an analyst would not hold a separate card for it.

matters.matter: AI chip sales in calendar 2026 (about $500 billion per Deloitte)
matters.why: With Nvidia holding about 80% of the market this figure is mostly Nvidia's own reported revenue, and its definition depends on the source, so no single public number settles it as a separate bet.

matters.matter: Whether the Kyber NVL144 / Rubin Ultra rack platform first ships in 2027 or slips to 2028
matters.why: A slip of more than a year in Nvidia's next flagship rack platform shifts revenue timing and weakens its scale-up edge against competitors, and Nvidia's earnings calls and launch announcements will show when it first ships.

matters.matter: Global HBM shipment growth in calendar 2027 (projected at about 50%-60%)
matters.why: HBM supply limits Nvidia's GPU output and memory prices are pushing its gross margin down, and 2027 shipment data and memory makers' reports will settle the growth.

matters.matter: Whether HBM supply remains short of demand in calendar 2027
matters.why: Whether supply stays short is the same supply question as shipment growth seen from the demand side, so an analyst would track it on the same card rather than as a separate bet.
